designations.eng: Nominal capacity (of the tank or compartment)

eng: Nominal capacity (of the tank or compartment)

terms.designation: Nominal capacity (of the tank or compartment)

definitions.content: Volume indicated (marked) on the tank or its compartment.

notes.content: The nominal capacity value usually corresponds to the volume of liquid which a tank or compartment contains at reference temperature when filled up to the maximum permissible level or volume mark.
The nominal capacity value can be limited by safety regulations.
